sentences.text:
For the Informant: Mr. Shahid Yunus, Advocate ---
03 / 05.08.2025 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Jamua P.S. Case No. 37 of 2024 for the offences registered under sections 323/341/365/498A/506/304(B)/201/34 of the Indian Penal Code and section 3 & 4 of D.P. Act., pending in the court of Ms. Sushila Hansda, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Giridih.
3. Petitioner happens to be the brother-in-law of the deceased Sahin Praveen who died in her matrimonial home.
Her dead body was thrown in the nearby forest.
4. It appears that on the basis of confession of Guddu Singh, dead body of the deceased was recovered.
As far as the petitioner is concerned, there is general allegation against him.
It further appears that nothing was recovered on the pointing out of this petitioner.
It further appears that similarly situated co- accused persons Md. Rafik and Md. Salauddin have been granted bail by this court earlier.
